records.title: metadata drift — barrel export counts diverge
records.remediation: Re-run Create Skill, which rebuilds `exports[]` and `stats.exports_public_api` in `skills/oms-cocoindex/1.0.0/oms-cocoindex/metadata.json` from the source. Update Skill does not repair this drift: each time it writes the skill it recounts `stats.exports_public_api` from the source and keeps `exports[]`, adding or dropping only the names its provenance map changes, so a metadata patch does not hold.
records.issue: stats.exports_public_api=140, exports[].length=118 → 16% drift

records.title: Discovery testing not performed: subagents unavailable, routing test requires isolated context
records.remediation: Re-run test-skill for oms-cocoindex in an environment that can spawn subagents, so §4b.2 can route three realistic prompts (for example 'set up an incremental vector index over my markdown docs with postgres') against the catalog of oms-cocoindex, oms-cognee, oms-storybook-react-vite and oms-uitripled using the frontmatter description in skills/oms-cocoindex/1.0.0/oms-cocoindex/SKILL.md:3.
records.issue: The catalog holds 4 skills, so the routing test applies, but this run could not spawn an isolated subagent; answering the routing in the main thread, which knows the skill under test, would self-route and inflate the result.
